title: Bubble Developer available — agency overflow, white-label & part-time work (CET)
text: Hi Bubblers I’m Vitalii, a Bubble.io developer behind KrylonTech, based in Europe (CET time zone). I’m looking for my first long-term collaboration — with an agency that needs extra hands or a founder who needs a reliable builder. What I built in Bubble: Relational data structures: Thing references, Option Sets, no duplicated data Privacy Rules and role-based access (admin / seller / customer setups) Workflows and backend workflows, custom events, custom states API Connector integrations, Stripe payments Responsive UI with the new responsive engine, Figma → Bubble Reusable elements and style systems: color/font tokens, consistent states Automation with n8n and AI integrations Projects: E-Pharmacy — medicine delivery marketplace: catalog, cart, orders, Stripe checkout, role-based dashboards Growly — soft-skills learning platform with automatic PDF certificate generation SoloFlow — operations/CRM platform for freelancers (in progress) ClientPortal — client-facing portal (in progress) Case studies with screenshots: https://krylontech-portfolio.vercel.app/ What I’m looking for: Agency overflow or white-label work (Figma pages, dashboards, integrations, bug fixes) Part-time or full-time remote role in a Bubble team Smaller, well-defined tasks to start with Honest note: I’m early in my commercial career, so I’m flexible on rates. Availability: 30 h/week, CET, English B2 (upper-intermediate) Contact: DM me here on the forum Email: vitaliipietukhov@gmail.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/vitalii-pietukhov Telegram: @vitalii_bioome Thanks for reading, and feel free to reach out even for a small task! 1 post - 1 participant Read full topic
